# haishoku

> Verified open data for the 348 color combinations and 159 named colors in Sanzo Wada’s Haishoku Soukan (配色総鑑, 1933–34), as printed in Seigensha’s bilingual A Dictionary of Color Combinations (2010, ISBN 978-4-86152-247-5). Compiled by Bill Mageni. For screens, use display_hex.

The book itself is not in this repository. Screen colors are white-balanced scans and approximate the printed page. Three darks — Deep Indigo #21192D, Black #1E1D21, and Dull Violet Black #261B39 — are hard to separate on a display. Four-color combinations are ordered top, left, right, bottom. Two- and three-color combinations are ordered left to right. Keep printed spellings (Cerulian, Antwarp, Vandar Poel's, Vistoris, Kronbergs). Eugenia Red and Grayish Lavender each have an a and a b variant; they are different swatches.

Code is MIT. The data compilation is CC BY 4.0. Attribute Bill Mageni (https://github.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku) and credit Sanzo Wada for the combinations.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/blob/main/README.md): What the dataset is, which file to open, and which hex to use.
- [Palette viewer](https://bjoseph23.github.io/haishoku/viewer/): Search, filter, and copy hex values. Also works by opening viewer/index.html locally.
- [AI guide](https://github.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/blob/main/docs/AI_GUIDE.md): System prompt for custom GPTs and Claude Projects, plus example prompts.
- [Data dictionary](https://github.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/blob/main/docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md): Every column and JSON field.
- [Methodology](https://github.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/blob/main/docs/METHODOLOGY.md): How the pages were read, and the limits of the screen colors.
- [Use cases](https://github.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/blob/main/docs/USE_CASES.md): Applying a combination, including 60/30/10 and contrast.

## Data files

- [Canonical JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/main/data/wada_colors_and_combinations.json): 159 colors and 348 combinations, with per-swatch sample, OCR score, and delta E.
- [colors.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/main/data/colors.csv): One row per named color. appears_in is a space-separated list of zero-padded combination numbers.
- [combinations.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/main/data/combinations.csv): One row per combination. Slots 3 and 4 are empty when unused.
- [display-hex.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/main/data/derived/display-hex.json): Map of printed name to display_hex. Smallest file that still names every color.

## Derived palettes

Generated from the JSON. Screen files use display_hex. The CMYK ASE file stores the printed ink percentages.

- [CSS variables](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/main/data/derived/colors.css)
- [Combination classes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/main/data/derived/combinations.css)
- [Tailwind colors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/main/data/derived/tailwind.colors.json)
- [GIMP/Inkscape GPL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/main/data/derived/haishoku.gpl)
- [Adobe ASE, screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/main/data/derived/haishoku-rgb.ase)
- [Adobe ASE, printed CMYK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bjoseph23/haishoku/main/data/derived/haishoku-cmyk.ase)

## Counts

- 159 colors, ids 1–159, reference pages 285–351 in the scan.
- 348 combinations: 120 of size 2 (pages 28–87), 120 of size 3 (pages 90–149), 108 of size 4 (pages 152–259).
- 1,032 color-to-combination slots. All 348 combinations are confidence verified-visual.
- Etruscan Red (id 19) is C16 M80 Y74 K6.

## Instructions for models

- Choose colors and combinations that exist in the file. Quote the combination number, the printed names, and display_hex.
- Recommend proportions separately from the book order. The book prints swatches at equal size. A useful starting split is 60/30/10.
- For text on a background, check contrast. Large fields of similar lightness can be the point of a Wada pair and still be unreadable as type.
- hex_cmyk is a naive conversion kept for compatibility. The printed specification is the c, m, y, k integers.
- Do not invent Japanese names. They were not published in this release.
- Do not "correct" historical spellings.
- Do not claim the palette meets WCAG by default.
